entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your time in the Dimension of Dreams has improved your ability to manipulate its landscape.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Lucid Dreamer, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can reroll a failed attempt to perform an impossible action, such as casting a spell you can’t normally cast, gaining an effect of a spell as if it had been cast, or conjuring a magic item. You also gain an additional +2 bonus on Charisma checks to determine your initial condition when entering a dream with your lucid body.
